title: Abyssal Worms
tagline: Glowing worms crawling the floor of a deep, dark sea.
teaser: The worms of a 1980 terminal reborn as bioluminescent creatures of the deep, crawling exactly where the original sent them. Watch for sightings, meet all eight species in the journal, take the Daily Dive, keep postcards of the scenes you like, or split the screen to see the old terminal.

manPage.synopsis: worms — watch worms wander; change how many and how fast.
manPage.description: Eric P. Scott’s worms animated little worms crawling around a display terminal. It returns as a smooth, colourful screensaver. A logbook keeps the sightings you catch, a journal the species you meet, and a Daily Dive digs the same abyss for everyone; postcards keep the scenes you like.

howToPlay: Let the worms crawl; S opens the settings, C the 1980 terminal, V a split screen.
When a ring of light marks the floor, click it (or press L) to log the sighting.
Click a worm to meet its species; B opens the logbook and today's Daily Dive.
